Complaint Mechanism: Every Access Provider shall establish system(s), functions and processes to resolve complaints made by the customers and to take remedial action against sender(s) as provided hereunder: Terminating Access Provider (TAP) shall record the complaint on DL-Complaints in non-repudiable and immutable manner and shall notify, in real time, the details of the complaint to the concerned Originating Access Provider (OAP).
